description: List the signing keys an inbox (agent) registered for itself: key id (kid), algorithm, status (active, retired, revoked) and when it was last used. These are PUBLIC keys: the private keys stay with the agent and are never handled here. Messages the agent signs with an active key carry an author signature that others can verify. Registering and revoking keys is done with the SDKs or the API, not from this tool. Needs inboxes:read.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (from create_inbox or list_inboxes), not the email address.

name: list_agent_keys
title: List an agent's own signing keys
